business_units.IGB_REIT: Retail malls - Mid Valley Megamall, The Gardens, Southkey Megamall

property_investment.description: Rental income analysis from retail malls, offices, hotels

rental_revenue.definition: Total rental income including base rent, service charge, turnover rent
rental_revenue.implementation: FAGLFLEXA.RACCT IN (SELECT VALFROM FROM SETLEAF WHERE SETNAME = 'RENTAL_REVENUE')

service_charge_revenue.definition: Service charge and maintenance fee income
service_charge_revenue.implementation: FAGLFLEXA.RACCT IN (SELECT VALFROM FROM SETLEAF WHERE SETNAME = 'SERVICE_CHARGE_REV')

occupancy_rate_proxy.definition: Rental revenue vs budgeted/full-potential revenue (requires plan data)
occupancy_rate_proxy.note: Actual occupancy from RE-FX RECN; proxy from revenue trend if RE-FX unavailable

hr_property_management.description: Headcount cost for property management teams (mall ops, security, cleaning, leasing)

property_headcount_cost.definition: Salaries and benefits of staff assigned to each property
property_headcount_cost.implementation: FAGLFLEXA.RACCT IN (SELECT VALFROM FROM SETLEAF WHERE SETNAME = 'PERSONNEL_COST')

cost_per_sqft.definition: Property management cost divided by lettable area (requires non-SAP area data)
cost_per_sqft.note: Link to external area master if available

FAGLFLEXA.description: General Ledger Actual Line Items (New GL) - PRIMARY source for all IGB financial analysis
FAGLFLEXA.business_purpose: Rental revenue by property, HR cost by property, mall-level P&L

columns.RBUKRS: Company Code - IGB REIT (5211), IGB Commercial, etc.
columns.RCNTR: Cost Center - property management cost center (e.g., MV-SECURITY, MV-OPS)
columns.PRCTR: Profit Center - PROPERTY LEVEL (e.g., MV-MALL, TG-MALL, SK-MALL)
columns.RACCT: GL Account - rental income, service charge, personnel expense
columns.SEGMENT: Segment reporting (IFRS 8) - may map to business unit

usage_rules.rental_analysis: ALWAYS filter by PRCTR for property-level view; use RACCT set for revenue type
usage_rules.hr_cost_analysis: ALWAYS filter by RCNTR for team-level view; join CSKS for property mapping
usage_rules.performance_note: Table is large. Always include RYEAR + POPER filters. Never SELECT *.

CEPC.description: Profit Center Master - EACH MALL / PROPERTY IS A PROFIT CENTER
CEPC.business_purpose: Property-level P&L reporting. Mid Valley Megamall = one profit center.

columns.PRCTR: Profit Center Code (e.g., MV001, TG001, SK001)

CSKS.description: Cost Center Master - PROPERTY MANAGEMENT TEAMS
CSKS.business_purpose: Cost centers for mall operations: security, cleaning, maintenance, leasing, admin

columns.PRCTR: Linked Profit Center - bridges cost to property revenue

BSEG.business_purpose: Trace individual rent invoices, vendor payments for property services

columns.SGTXT: Item Text - may contain tenant name or invoice reference

usage_rules.rental_invoice_trace: Use with BKPF to find rent invoice documents
usage_rules.tenant_payment: Filter by customer/vendor + GL account for rental income

BKPF.business_purpose: Document type identifies payroll run (HR) vs rent invoice (RE)

columns.BLART: Document Type: HR=Payroll, DR=Customer Invoice, DZ=Customer Payment, KR=Vendor Invoice

BUT000.business_purpose: Tenant companies leasing space in IGB malls (e.g., ZARA, Uniqlo, Parkson)
BUT000.link_to_re_fx: RECN partner assignment via BP relationship

SETLEAF.description: Set Values - GL ACCOUNT GROUPING for IGB reporting
SETLEAF.business_purpose: Define 'Rental Revenue', 'Service Charge', 'Personnel Cost' account groups

critical_sets.RENTAL_REVENUE: All GL accounts for base rent + turnover rent
critical_sets.SERVICE_CHARGE_REV: All GL accounts for service charge + maintenance
critical_sets.PERSONNEL_COST: All GL accounts for salaries, wages, EPF, SOCSO

T001W.description: Plants / Locations - may map to individual mall branches

relationships.join: FAGLFLEXA.PRCTR = CEPC.PRCTR AND FAGLFLEXA.BUDAT BETWEEN CEPC.DATAB AND CEPC.DATBI
relationships.description: Property revenue/cost linkage - profit center = mall

relationships.join: FAGLFLEXA.RCNTR = CSKS.KOSTL AND FAGLFLEXA.BUDAT BETWEEN CSKS.DATAB AND CSKS.DATBI
relationships.description: Cost center to property: CSKS.PRCTR links to CEPC
Cost center belongs to profit center (property)

relationships.join: BSEG.BUKRS = BKPF.BUKRS AND BSEG.BELNR = BKPF.BELNR AND BSEG.GJAHR = BKPF.GJAHR
relationships.description: Document header for BSEG line items

rental_revenue_by_property.description: Total rental revenue per mall/property by period
rental_revenue_by_property.sql_pattern: SELECT p.KTEXT AS property, SUM(f.HSL) AS revenue FROM FAGLFLEXA f JOIN CEPC p ON f.PRCTR = p.PRCTR AND f.BUDAT BETWEEN p.DATAB AND p.DATBI JOIN CEPCT pt ON p.PRCTR = pt.PRCTR AND pt.SPRAS = 'E' WHERE f.RACCT IN (SELECT VALFROM FROM SETLEAF WHERE SETNAME = 'RENTAL_REVENUE') AND f.RYEAR = ? AND f.POPER = ? GROUP BY p.KTEXT

property_headcount_cost.description: HR cost per property (via cost center → profit center rollup)
property_headcount_cost.sql_pattern: SELECT pt.KTEXT AS property, SUM(f.HSL) AS hr_cost FROM FAGLFLEXA f JOIN CSKS c ON f.RCNTR = c.KOSTL AND f.BUDAT BETWEEN c.DATAB AND c.DATBI JOIN CEPC p ON c.PRCTR = p.PRCTR JOIN CEPCT pt ON p.PRCTR = pt.PRCTR AND pt.SPRAS = 'E' WHERE f.RACCT IN (SELECT VALFROM FROM SETLEAF WHERE SETNAME = 'PERSONNEL_COST') AND f.RYEAR = ? AND f.POPER = ? GROUP BY pt.KTEXT

rental_revenue_per_headcount.description: Revenue per property management staff (requires HR headcount from external source)
rental_revenue_per_headcount.note: SQL gives revenue and cost; headcount denominator from HR module or manual input

service_charge_vs_base_rent.description: Split of rental income: base rent vs service charge
service_charge_vs_base_rent.sql_pattern: SELECT pt.KTEXT AS property, CASE WHEN f.RACCT IN (SELECT VALFROM FROM SETLEAF WHERE SETNAME = 'RENTAL_REVENUE') THEN 'Base Rent' WHEN f.RACCT IN (SELECT VALFROM FROM SETLEAF WHERE SETNAME = 'SERVICE_CHARGE_REV') THEN 'Service Charge' END AS revenue_type, SUM(f.HSL) AS amount FROM FAGLFLEXA f JOIN CEPC p ON f.PRCTR = p.PRCTR JOIN CEPCT pt ON p.PRCTR = pt.PRCTR AND pt.SPRAS = 'E' WHERE f.RYEAR = ? AND f.POPER = ? GROUP BY pt.KTEXT, revenue_type

table_selection.property_revenue: Use FAGLFLEXA with PRCTR (profit center) dimension. Do NOT use BSEG for aggregations.
table_selection.property_cost: Use FAGLFLEXA with RCNTR (cost center) dimension, then roll up to PRCTR via CSKS.
table_selection.document_trace: Use BKPF + BSEG only when user asks 'which document' or 'show me the invoice'.
table_selection.tenant_info: Use BUT000 only if available. If RE-FX tables (RECN) are not in schema, state limitation.

mandatory_filters.FAGLFLEXA: ALWAYS include RYEAR and POPER. Table is massive.
mandatory_filters.CSKS: ALWAYS include BUDAT BETWEEN DATAB AND DATBI.
mandatory_filters.CEPC: ALWAYS include BUDAT BETWEEN DATAB AND DATBI.
mandatory_filters.text_tables: ALWAYS include SPRAS = 'E' for English descriptions.

igb_specific.profit_centers: Map PRCTR to mall name via CEPCT. Do not guess mall names.
igb_specific.rental_income_accounts: Never hardcode GL account numbers. Always use SETLEAF with SETNAME.
